sql: SELECT t1.narrative, t1.amount, t1.measures FROM readings t1 JOIN subjects t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t2.title='Mr.' AND t2.given='Vincent' AND t2.surname='Wyman' AND t1.day='2010-08-02' AND t1.narrative='Body Height'
SELECT DISTINCT r.commonness_share FROM rate_rollup r JOIN diagnoses d ON lower(r.element)=lower(d.narrative) WHERE d.token='64859006'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subjects t1 JOIN drugs t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t2.narrative='Ibuprofen 200 MG Oral Tablet' AND t1.culture='dominican' AND strftime('%Y',t2.onset)='2016' AND strftime('%m',t2.finish)-strftime('%m',t2.onset)=1
SELECT DISTINCT d.person FROM diagnoses d JOIN rate_rollup r ON lower(r.element)=lower(d.narrative) WHERE r.commonness_share=18.8
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subjects t1 JOIN shots t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t1.given='Keven' AND t1.surname='Kuhn' AND t2.narrative='DTaP'
SELECT t1.given, t1.surname FROM subjects t1 JOIN drugs t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t2.narrative='Clopidogrel 75 MG Oral Tablet' AND strftime('%Y',t2.finish)-strftime('%Y',t2.onset)>10
SELECT r.commonness_proportion FROM rate_rollup r JOIN diagnoses d ON lower(r.element)=lower(d.narrative) WHERE d.onset='2014-05-09'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.narrative='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(t2.person), SUM(CASE WHEN t1.culture='english' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM subjects t1 JOIN shots t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE strftime('%Y',t2.day)='2017'
